note: What a server sends to make a turret. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: turret
fields.note: The name the turret answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the object belongs to, in a field of its own.

fields.name: unread
fields.note: A client reads nothing here. A server writes zero.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What this turret is called. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The character it is. Written and padded as above.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Nonzero for side 100, zero for side 200.
